description: Figure 2 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the accuracy comparison of different models on paraphrase sentiment and STS tasks. The horizontal axis lists five model configurations: “Single-task_Baseline”, “Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout”, “Unsupervised_SimCSE”, “Supervised_SimCSE”, and “2-Tier SimCSE”. The vertical axis represents “Accuracy / Correlation” and is scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. For each model, three bars are grouped side-by-side, each representing a different task: “Sentiment Acc.” (light yellow), “STS Core” (pink), and “Paraphrase Acc.” (light blue). The height of each bar corresponds to its respective accuracy score. The “Single-task_Baseline” model shows the lowest accuracy across all tasks, with values approximately 0.55 for Sentiment Acc., 0.50 for STS Core, and 0.65 for Paraphrase Acc. The “2-Tier SimCSE” model demonstrates the highest accuracy, particularly for STS Core (approximately 0.75) and Paraphrase Acc. (approximately 0.70), while its Sentiment Acc. is slightly lower, around 0.55. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order of the model configurations listed on the x-axis.
